question: My outdoor hosebib is leaking and I want to fix it. What are the steps to follow?
answer: To fix a dripping outdoor hosebib, first shut off the water supply by locating the shut-off valves behind the faucet and turning them clockwise. Next, disconnect the hose from the hosebib and remove any visible mineral buildup. Apply a thread sealant to the threads of the hosebib and reattach the hose. Finally, turn the water supply back on and check for leaks.

safety_info: Be aware of the risk of water electrocution when working with outdoor plumbing. Make sure the power to any nearby outdoor outlets is turned off before starting the repair.
tips: Use a wrench to loosen any corroded or stuck parts.

Make sure to tighten the shut-off valves securely after turning the water supply back on.
